shell.documentBar: fixed second row with active and dirty document state
shell.leftPanel: project, world tree, or source asset list for the active document

bottomDock.behavior: overlay; opening or closing does not resize the center canvas

shell.statusBar: fixed bottom row with message, saved/modified state, undo/redo depth, validation state, and bottom-panel toggle

panelRules: Project and Inspector panels can be hidden independently without replacing the active document.
Bottom panels overlay the canvas instead of resizing it when toggled.
Project, Inspector, and bottom-dock splitters resize interactively and save their normalized dimensions.
The status bar remains visible regardless of panel visibility.
Panel visibility and dimensions persist locally and never become game-save authority.
Editor shell state does not require network access.

buildRepair.rule: test modules remain after production impl items
